question: As per WHO (World Health Organization), which of the following is NOT an example of disinfection by-products formed at traditional drinking water treatment plants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Titania.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Bromate, Chlorite, and Chlorate are examples of disinfection by-products formed at traditional drinking water treatment plants.**

 
 
• **Hence Titania is NOT an example of disinfection by-products formed at traditional drinking water treatment plants.**
 
 
 
• Water treatment plants** add chlorine **to drinking water **to kill or inactivate harmful organisms in a process called “disinfection.”**
 
• During this process, **chlorine also reacts with naturally occurring organic matter** that may be present in drinking water.
 
• **Disinfection by-products (DBPs) are intermediate compounds** formed after the c**hemical treatment of water for the removal of geogenic and microbial contaminants.**
